Loss report: forgejo -> woodpecker
[lost] pipeline/ci pipeline.inputs (Woodpecker has no typed pipeline inputs)
[lost] pipeline/ci/job/test job.runner (the runner label ${{ matrix.os }} has no Woodpecker label key: a key needs letters, digits, dot, underscore or dash)
[external] pipeline/ci/job/test/step/test-step-1 script.interpolation: secret for variable; environment variable for input (variable LEVEL is bound to the secret LEVEL; Woodpecker has no variables, so create the secret LEVEL with the value of the variable; input target is read as the variable target, which nothing sets; define it in the Woodpecker environment)
[emulated] pipeline/ci pipeline.env: copied into the environment of every step (a step variable of the same name wins)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/test job.container: default image ubuntu:latest (the job names no image, so steps without one run in ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/test/step/test-step-1 step.shell: bash-if-present wrapper command (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; Woodpecker runs commands through /bin/sh -e of the image, so one command re-runs the script under bash -e when the image has bash, else under sh -e, and bash-only syntax fails under sh)
